description: Deploy Tennis API through the administrator-installed root script. No caller-supplied commands.

CommitSha.description: Latest master commit with successful CI

runCommand: [[ "${SSM_CommitSha:-}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid or unavailable commit parameter.' >&2; exit 1; }
[[ "${SSM_ImageDigest:-}" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid or unavailable image digest.' >&2; exit 1; }
